name: Apollo Electric LLC
subject: ⚡ Matt, two phone numbers and a Yahoo email
body:
Hi Matt,

Two small things on Apollo Electric that could be costing you calls. The website shows 480-216-6733, but your Google listing shows 480-405-7591, so customers get a different number depending on where they find you. And the business still runs on a personal Yahoo email, which makes a licensed contractor look smaller than he is.

You are a second-generation electrician. The online side should match that.

So I redesigned the Apollo homepage, and the finished design is attached to this email as a PDF. One number throughout, 480-216-6733, your services laid out cleanly, and your second-generation story up front where customers can actually see it. A proper business email is an easy next step after that.

I build websites for electrical companies. DP Electric is one of mine, with contact details consistent everywhere a customer might look. Electrician Squad (electriciansquad.com) is another, simple layout, services clear, one tap to call from any page.

Just reply here and tell me what you think.

Best,
Hassan
